questions.prompt: A server experiences sudden **GPU compute stalls** despite 100% GPU core capability. `nvidia-smi` shows PCIe Gen1 link width instead of Gen4 x16. What is the likely bottleneck?

options.text: Host-to-device PCIe bandwidth bottleneck from seating the GPU in a low-lane/shared slot or power-saving link state

questions.prompt: Why does **NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access)** matter on dual-socket servers?

options.text: NUMA removes the need for a motherboard
RAM attached to Socket 0 is faster for Socket 0 cores than cross-socket RAM on Socket 1

questions.prompt: Match each RAID level to its fault tolerance and trade-off.

columns.label: 50% usable capacity, survives 1 drive failure with fast rebuild
N-1 capacity, survives 1 drive failure, slow parity rebuild risk on huge HDDs
50% usable capacity, high random IOPS and fast rebuilds

questions.prompt: Why is **RAID 5** discouraged for modern multi-terabyte HDD arrays?

options.text: Rebuilding a failed 16 TB drive stresses surviving drives for days, risking a second drive failure or URE (unrecoverable read error)

questions.prompt: Which symptoms indicate **thermal or power throttling** on a compute node? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: CPU/GPU clock speeds dropping well below base/boost under sustained load
Kernel/BMC logs showing power-cap or thermal events

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of **NVMe-oF** or **10/25/100GbE** in clustered compute?

options.text: Providing low-latency, high-throughput interconnects so storage and distributed nodes don't stall on 1GbE

questions.prompt: Which Linux command checks PCIe link speed and width for an attached device?
What happens when a system runs out of **RAM** and falls back heavily to **disk swap**?

options.text: Throughput collapses (thrashing) because disk/SSD page faults are orders of magnitude slower than DRAM

questions.prompt: What is **write amplification** on NAND flash SSDs?

options.text: Flash must erase whole blocks before rewriting pages, causing more physical flash writes than host writes

questions.prompt: Which maintenance actions extend **SSD endurance and performance**? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Monitoring SMART wear-leveling and media errors
Running defragmentation passes daily on SSDs
Leaving free space / over-provisioning unallocated or un-filled

questions.prompt: Why should **12VHPWR / high-wattage GPU power cables** be seated completely with no sharp bends?

options.text: Partial seating increases contact resistance, causing localized heating and melted connectors under 450W+ draw

questions.prompt: What is **VLAN tagging (802.1Q)** used for on server switches?

options.text: Logically isolating separate networks (e.g., management, storage, tenant traffic) over shared physical Ethernet trunks

questions.prompt: Match each hardware diagnostic tool to what it measures.

columns.label: Drive health, temperature, spare blocks, and media errors
Bit-level DRAM stability and address/cell faults
NIC link speed, duplex, and transceiver status

questions.prompt: Why do **enterprise SSDs** include **PLP (Power-Loss Protection)** capacitors?

options.text: To flush in-flight DRAM write-cache pages to NAND flash safely if AC power drops suddenly

questions.prompt: What is **airflow pressure** (positive vs. negative) in a server or workstation chassis?

options.text: Filtered intake exceeding exhaust (positive) pushes air out seams and reduces dust buildup

questions.prompt: Which practices improve **network reliability** in a server rack? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Labeling both ends of patch cables and keeping bend radius clean
Daisy-chaining 10 servers through one unmanaged desktop switch
Dual top-of-rack switches with LACP/MLAG bonding
Separating BMC/IPMI management onto an isolated management VLAN

questions.prompt: What does `ethtool -S eth0` help an operator diagnose?

options.text: NIC packet drops, CRC errors, and ring-buffer overruns

questions.prompt: Why is **LTO magnetic tape** still used for large-scale archival backups?

options.text: Tape offers unmatched $/TB density, 30-year shelf life, and true offline air-gapping against cyberattacks

questions.prompt: What is **Bifurcation** on a PCIe x16 motherboard slot?

options.text: Splitting a x16 slot into e.g. x8/x8 or x4/x4/x4/x4 to host multiple NVMe or expansion cards

questions.prompt: What is **false sharing** in multi-core CPU caches?

options.text: Two cores modifying different variables that happen to sit on the same 64-byte cache line, causing constant cache invalidations

questions.prompt: Which checks belong in a **hardware burn-in** before placing a new server in production? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Skipping all tests and shipping straight to prod
Sustained CPU/GPU thermal & power load test
Full disk/NVMe read-write and SMART verification

questions.prompt: What is **RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access)** (e.g., RoCEv2 / InfiniBand)?

options.text: Allowing one node to read/write another node's memory directly over the network, bypassing OS kernel copies

questions.prompt: What does **MTU 9000 (Jumbo Frames)** do on a dedicated storage/cluster network?

options.text: Increases frame payload from 1500 to 9000 bytes, reducing per-packet header and interrupt overhead

questions.prompt: Why must **MTU 9000** be configured consistently on every switch and host along a path?

options.text: Mismatched MTUs silently drop or fragment large packets, causing severe throughput stalls

questions.prompt: Match each power/cooling metric to what it guides.

columns.label: Battery load capacity and hold-up runtime during mains loss
Room air-conditioning capacity needed to remove IT heat
Surviving one failed PSU/cooling unit without losing capacity

questions.prompt: What is **SLC / TLC / QLC** in SSD NAND flash?

options.text: Bits stored per flash cell (1, 3, or 4 bits) — fewer bits/cell gives higher endurance and sustained write speed

questions.prompt: What does `sensors` (lm-sensors) display on Linux?

options.text: CPU package temperatures, motherboard voltages, and fan RPMs

questions.prompt: Why is **DDR5**'s on-die ECC NOT equivalent to full **server ECC**?

options.text: On-die ECC only corrects internal DRAM cell errors inside the chip, not transmission errors across the memory bus to the CPU
Server ECC is slower than HDD

questions.prompt: What is **PCIe hot-plug** (U.2 / E1.S / EDSFF) designed for?

options.text: Swapping enterprise NVMe drives from front bays without shutting down the host

questions.prompt: Which indicators suggest a **failing HDD** that should be replaced immediately? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Clicking/grinding mechanical noises and I/O timeout errors in `dmesg`
Read/write latency spiking to seconds on healthy blocks
Quiet steady idle operation with 0 SMART errors

questions.prompt: In a **3-tier backup** plan, what is the purpose of **verify-by-restore**?

options.text: Confirming backup files can actually be mounted, decrypted, and booted/restored within RTO

questions.prompt: What is **SR-IOV** on server NICs?

options.text: Splitting one physical NIC into multiple hardware-isolated Virtual Functions assigned directly to VMs/containers

questions.prompt: What is **IOPS** vs. **Sequential MB/s**?

options.text: IOPS measures small random I/O operations per second; MB/s measures bulk sustained throughput

questions.prompt: Which command inspects recent kernel hardware/disk/PCIe error messages?
Why do high-density GPU servers often require **liquid cooling** (direct-to-chip or immersion)?

options.text: It removes the need for PSUs
Air cooling struggles to dissipate 700W–1000W+ per accelerator in dense 2U/4U chassis

questions.prompt: What is **active vs. passive** DAC/AOC cabling in 25G/100G racks?

options.text: Passive copper DACs are cheap for short (<3m) in-rack links; active/optical AOCs reach farther with lower weight

questions.prompt: Which factors cause **system bottlenecks** even with a fast CPU? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: OS/database running on a slow 5400 RPM HDD
Saturated 1GbE NIC during heavy storage/cluster traffic

questions.prompt: What is **TPM 2.0** (Trusted Platform Module) used for on modern motherboards?

options.text: Hardware root-of-trust for measured boot, BitLocker/LUKS disk encryption keys, and device attestation

questions.prompt: Why should **server firmware (BIOS/UEFI, BMC, NIC, SSD)** be kept on tested, consistent versions across a fleet?

options.text: Firmware updates fix silent data-loss bugs, security vulnerabilities, and stability regressions

questions.prompt: What is **hardware watchdog** (`watchdog` timer) in servers?

options.text: A hardware timer that automatically resets a frozen host if the OS stops heartbeating

questions.prompt: When sizing a **workstation or server PSU**, why is **+12V rail amperage** more important than total label wattage alone?

options.text: CPUs and GPUs draw almost all their power from the +12V rail(s)

questions.prompt: What defines a **well-engineered hardware/infrastructure design**?

options.text: Balancing compute, memory bandwidth, storage IOPS, network, power/cooling headroom, and redundancy to match the workload
Skipping backups because RAID is enabled
Buying the most expensive GPU regardless of workload
